title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
kidExplanation: Story version: The key idea is to perform binary search to find the minimum element in the rotated sorted array. We compare the middle element with its neighbors to determine if it is the minimum element. Depending on the comparison, we narrow down the search to the unsorted part of the array.
